title: Human hair, unworked, whether or not washed or scoured; waste of human hair

review.classification: UNSD CPC 3.0 p. 197 explicitly includes unworked human hair whether or not washed or scoured at 38971. Its neighbour 38972 includes dressed, thinned, bleached or otherwise worked hair and wigs. The candidate preserves cut direction, avoids downstream preparation and defines a genuine raw product rather than a salon service or a finished hairpiece.
review.primary_evidence: Banbury Postiche documents market purchase, the pre-cut securing of root-aligned ponytails, individual suitability assessment and return of refused material. Its policy describes its sourcing practice and cannot certify an individual source. The Little Princess Trust donor guide independently documents clean, dry, secured hair. Its donation terms and different colour rules cannot prove the supplier conditions of a purchased lot.
review.repair_and_measurement: At independent pre-review the author was asked to distinguish actual first-cut material from re-traded released hair, retain opening/closing WIP burdens and prove the source-to-release link. The final author version implements those conditions. It also explicitly separates per-article supplier/accompanied and first non-purchase receipts from traceable prior-outward returns, retaining actual physical quantities and one provider burden. Reviewed English and Chinese first-release, zero-output, moisture and service allocation rules.
review.readiness: Each language contains 17 corresponding exchange cards. The targeted independent check performed 88 measurement checks with zero skips and 12 retained range warnings. Exact exchange identities, site measurements, source authorization and actual buyer specifications require foreground qualification. The authored candidate and aligned translation remain under their recorded review gates.
